don-tomas--clasico.description: Don Tomás comes from Danlí, Honduras, where the brand began in the 1970s, and the Clasico returns it to its Honduran roots: an oily Honduran wrapper, offered natural or maduro, over long filler from Honduras and Nicaragua. Toasty wood and black pepper lead, with earth, cocoa and nuts filling in; a steady, generous smoke.

sources.title: Cigar Inspector – Don Tomás Clasico review
